name: 3DGS Model Compression Pipeline
definition: A compression scheme tailored for hardware deployment that reduces model size and bandwidth by iteratively pruning Gaussians, reducing spherical harmonics (SH) degree, and quantizing attributes.
summary: The 3DGS Model Compression Pipeline is a hardware-friendly scheme that achieves 51.6x compression by iteratively pruning Gaussians, reducing spherical harmonics degree, and applying vector quantization.
